name: Lesotho
description: Lesotho, the mountain kingdom, from Moshoeshoe I to British Basutoland, independence in 1966 and the water it sells to South Africa.

checkpoints.name: Moshoeshoe's kingdom
checkpoints.note: Moshoeshoe gathered people scattered by war and held off Boers and Zulus from Thaba Bosiu.

checkpoints.name: Basutoland
checkpoints.note: Moshoeshoe asked for British protection in 1868, which kept Lesotho out of South Africa.

checkpoints.name: Independent Lesotho
checkpoints.note: Independence came in 1966, then coups and unrest. The mountains' water became a main export.
